decisions.reason: The complete-and-working delivery condition does not change the existing decision that separate hosting and a custom domain are not required.
The source establishes a delivery acceptance condition and clickable access but does not change the exclusion of Shopify.
Requiring a complete working page and customer-accessible link does not alter the product positioning, target customers, messaging emphasis, or marketing purpose.
The delivery acceptance condition does not modify the required lively visual tone or child-and-restaurant imagery.
